name: ChatGPT
summary: Opt out of AI training, disable persistent memory, and use Temporary Chat for sensitive queries.

settings.name: AI Model Training Opt-Out
clickPath: Improve the model for everyone: Toggle OFF
settings.impact: By default your conversations are used to train future OpenAI models, including potential review by human contractors. Disabling ensures future conversations are not used for model training.
settings.source: OpenAI Help Center: 'What if I want to keep my history on but disable model training?'; Tom's Guide: 'Keep your ChatGPT data private'

settings.name: Memory
clickPath: Toggle OFF or Manage Memory to review and delete stored facts
settings.impact: ChatGPT Memory stores facts about you across conversations (health conditions, beliefs, relationships). This data is retained indefinitely unless manually deleted.
settings.source: OpenAI Memory FAQ; OpenAI Memory Controls announcement

settings.name: Temporary Chat
settings.impact: Temporary chats are not saved to history, do not update Memory, and are not used for model training. Use this mode for sensitive medical, legal, or personal queries.
settings.source: OpenAI Help Center: Temporary Chat documentation; OpenAI Data Controls FAQ

settings.name: Chat History Deletion
settings.recommendedValue: Delete chats you do not need to retain
settings.impact: OpenAI retains conversation data for up to 30 days for safety review even with training disabled. Deleting chats reduces data available in any potential breach.

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: Your ChatGPT account may contain sensitive conversation history. Account takeover would expose past conversations and allow an attacker to use your API credits or subscription.
settings.source: OpenAI Account Security documentation; EFF 2FA guidance
